SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) Diary No(s). 31194/2025  [Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 23-04-2025  in MCRCA No.555/2025 passed by the High Court of Chhattisgarh at  Bilaspur]
 SARITA PANDEY Petitioner  VERSUS  STATE OF CHHATTISGARH Respondent  I.A. No.242943/2025-CONDONATION OF DELAY IN REFILING / CURING THE  DEFECTS  I.A. No.242944/2025-EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED  JUDGMENT I.A. No.242945/2025-EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.

entities.text: High Court of Chhattisgarh at  Bilaspur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This matter was called on for hearing today.

CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DIPANKAR DATTA HON'BLE MR.
JUSTICE AUGUSTINE GEORGE MASIH For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Rashid N. Azam , AOR For Respondent(s)

: 
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following O R D E R 1. Delay condoned.
2. Issue notice, returnable in four weeks.

3. Till the next date of hearing, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.411 of 2024 dated 31 st July, 2024 registered at Police Station Bemetara,
District Bemetara under Sections 34 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, subject to the petitioner joining investigation as and when called upon to do so by the investigating officer.
